'''Tervor "Riptide" Jheran''' served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was a famous [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] who used a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor]] in battle.<ref name="Kovor Ice Field" />

Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> he led a fleet to [[Battle above Kovor|attack]] a Republic patrol above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kovor]] but the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron was able to repel the Imperials and kill Jheran.<ref name="Kovor Ice Field" />
